parameters.image: Supplies the photo when one is available. The component uses its fallback otherwise.
parameters.width: Sets the width of the media frame.
parameters.height: Sets the height of the media frame.
parameters.aspectRatio: The box's width over its height, where one side is not given.
parameters.fit: Controls how the image fits inside its frame.
parameters.shape: Chooses the outline of the component.
parameters.shadow: Whether it stands raised in a shadow.
parameters.semanticLabel: Describes the picture independently of its fallback.
